title: Testimony of Christ: My Redeemer Lives Eternally
author: Spencer W. Kimball
source_file: epub/!Ready/Faith Precedes the Miracle - Spencer W Kimball.epub
note: 1972 Deseret Book. Classic Kimball treatise on the primacy of faith before divine intervention. His most-cited book. Written as Q12 (called Oct 1943), before his Oct 1973 call to Acting President and Dec 1973 call as Church President.
